case_revisions.problem: The investigation finished its fits but could not be saved: an identifiability value (an unbounded local uncertainty or condition number) was infinite and JSON storage refuses non-finite numbers.
case_revisions.fix: Non-finite numbers are stored as null (api.finite) and the condition number is null when undefined. Fit logic, thresholds and fixtures unchanged.
case_revisions.effect: Both cases now complete; their results come from the re-run.

case_revisions.problem: The verdict 'No change needed' described only the compared impulse; the precursor before the entered onset was flagged on the front and tail metrics ('Requires review') but not repeated next to the verdict.
case_revisions.fix: When the comparison carries rising-limb review flags or metrics marked 'Requires review', the verdict now states 'Requires review' and why. The verdict label and every threshold are unchanged.
case_revisions.effect: Wording only; no gate outcome changes.

cases: L 80 uH, front x0.25 (ringing in model)
case_revisions.problem: The unit-plausibility guard disabled the diagnosis with a message that suggested only a unit mistake, although the waveform was a strongly ringing in-model case whose half value is reached on the first swing.
case_revisions.fix: Message reworded to name both possibilities. The guard and its thresholds are unchanged, so the case still is not diagnosed quantitatively; this is reported as a limitation.

case_revisions.problem: Code review found that the colour match converted the whole working image to CIE Lab in float64, which could use over 1 GB of memory on a 4000-pixel image.
case_revisions.fix: The colour distance is computed only inside the plot area, in 256-row blocks of float32, and the background colour and suggestions sample at most about one megapixel.
case_revisions.effect: Re-running the full evaluation gave identical case results and gates (checked case by case; only run times differ). results.json is the run before this change.
